title: Plain lifecycle context segment format in the steward hook
summary: The context hook emits its lifecycle context segments as lifecycle-context-segment with formatVersion 1 instead of ia.lifecycle-context-segment.v1, and the lifecycle context they carry, its event and its profile are the plain lifecycle-context, lifecycle-event and lifecycle-profile formats. A binding registered before keeps working: its original ia.lifecycle-profile.v1 profile still verifies under its own digest, and a set of segments emitted under the original literal still assembles as written. Breaking: a consumer that matched the old segment literal must read formatVersion.
